html:
Tokentrim Free vs Paid

You can use Tokentrim for free or pay for the Pro version. The free version includes all hooks, 3 strength profiles, replay, dashboard, daily budget guard, and cold-cache alert.

How Tokentrim Works

Tokentrim trims tool output, reads files in ranges, and spools long output to disk. The full install sets a compaction window, which summarizes earlier conversations. This saved 75% on history re-read and made limits last 4.0x longer in the author's tests on 135 conversations.

What You Get

The free version of Tokentrim is free and open-source. The Pro version costs $49 once for a lifetime or $9/month. Pro adds a hosted dashboard on any device, Monday digest, weekly budget with alert at 80%, Slack totals, and use on up to 3 machines.

FAQ

What are the benefits of using Tokentrim? Tokentrim can save you money by reducing your Claude Code usage, with the author's tests showing a 55-70% reduction in billed cost. Is my data secure? Nothing leaves your machine by default, so your data is secure. How do I get started with Tokentrim? You can install Tokentrim as a plugin or via git clone.
